# railway_regions (Data Source)

Regions services can be deployed in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_regions" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project, to also include regions specific to its workspace.

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Available regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Country of the region.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the region, to be used in `regions` of `railway_service`.
- `location` (String) Location of the region.
- `name` (String) Name of the region.
